lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical alignment of four large, high-luminance circular spots is positioned immediately posterior to the gill slits, with a transition into a dense field of smaller, high-intensity spots extending anteriorly across the head and dorsally towards the ridge.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with a high-luminance upper ridge and a low-luminance shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-contrast distribution of high-luminance circular blobs, with larger diameter centroids concentrated near the proximal base and smaller, higher-density clusters near the leading edge.
